svg.text: LensS MLOps — Governed, Agentic AI Architecture for ML Operations
Every question follows one governed path: understood, routed, answered by an approved engine, checked, and logged.
Ask in plain English, quick or deep
Fleet health, action queues, every figure clickable
Same answers in other channels (ready to add)
Screens the question (guardrails) → reads the conversation → data or app guide · Quick or Deep → spots pushback, “not enough”, asking again
Answer cache first → gives each engine only the turns it missed → calls the chosen engine → merges the structured result into one answer
Governed Engines & Agents — each answers only from its approved sources (examples shown)
Execution Services & Governance — run identically for every engine
only gold views and metric views, rules read live
runs as the app’s service principal · users get no data access
figures reconciled · AI judge · 9-stage trace, every call logged
Governed Data Layer · Unity Catalog certified views, metric views & 4 business rules · Lakebase for conversations, cache and audit log
Every answer goes through the router, an approved engine and the checks — narrow prompts, controlled execution, full audit trail. People never get database access.
LensS MLOps · Concentrix Data & Analytics Practice
